summary_md:
**[@i_Am_Snow_Flake](https://x.com/i_Am_Snow_Flake/status/2115011873259348282)** summarizes **GenXR-Bench**, a benchmark of 112 XR app-development tasks for coding agents: even the top model (Opus 5) passes only ~51%.

The dominant failure (64.4% of failed runs, per the paper's Table 14) is comparing positions defined under different parent frames (e.g. hand vs world) without converting to a common frame. Other common failures: starting before assets or the headset load, cm-vs-m scale errors, and broken reset/undo.

referenced_urls.title: GenXR-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive XR Development

relevance: Pinpoints why agents struggle with 3D spatial code — coordinate frames and units — which is exactly what to guard against in 3D/XR agent tooling.
